name: loot_health_ring
description: Health-rider display (docs/loot.md 34.1): a bronze plain ring (derived id 132 = 0x64: material 1, plain, weapon ring) shows a green '+' OAM icon (font glyph tile 11, OBJ slot 3 -- no blob tile is free) plus a HEALTH RIDER detail line. Display-only: no status, no on-hit roll. Wood rings show it too (see ring_uses_loot_detail); on-hit riders still strip at wood (see loot_rider_strip).
